name: Santa Energy
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public santaenergy.com pages (home, Oil Pricing & Payment Options, Propane Pricing & Payment Options) and the public My Account sign-in page (info.santaenergy.com, powered by MyFuelPortal); no sign-in, no registration, no forms submitted. My Account: 'Log In' with 'Remember me?' and 'I forgot my password'; new users register with their Customer Number and Email Address. The sign-in field labels are not in the public text; MyFuelPortal sites sign in with the registered email (Lakes Gas's MyFuelPortal page says so), so email is modelled as inferred. Auto Pay: the monthly payment is charged automatically to a credit card or drawn from checking. ACH Discount: 15 cents per gallon for customers with paperless email statements who pay by automatic ACH (checking or savings) within seven days of the delivery/invoice date. Even Pay Budget Plan: 11 equal monthly payments. Heating oil price plans (all expire April 30): Daily Price (no enrollment), Fixed Price (signed agreement), Capped Plan (fee, amount not published, signed agreement), Pre-Buy. Propane: Value Flex Plan and Fixed Price Plan. Residential 800-937-2682, commercial 800-739-1852. Fees, late charges, guest payment and closing an account are not published on the pages used.

autopay.note: Auto Pay charges your monthly payment to a credit card or deducts it from your checking account.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Manage your Santa Energy account and pay online in My Account. With Auto Pay your monthly payment is charged automatically to your credit card or deducted from your checking account, so it is always on time.

ACH Discount: save 15 cents per gallon when you receive paperless email statements and pay by automatic ACH from checking or savings within seven days of the delivery or invoice date. Residential customers can call 800-937-2682; commercial customers 800-739-1852.
steps: Open My Account and log in.
Select a card or bank account and the amount.

help.title: Register for My Account
paragraphs: New users enter their Santa Energy Customer Number and email address and choose Register. The Walkthrough link on the sign-in page explains the portal, which is also available as a mobile app.

help.title: Even Pay Budget Plan and price plans
paragraphs: The Even Pay Budget Plan spreads your delivery costs over 11 equal monthly payments, so your bill stays the same through the season.

Heating oil price plans, which all expire April 30: Daily Price (pay the delivery-day rate, no enrollment form or fee), Fixed Price (a locked price per gallon, signed agreement required), Capped Plan (a not-to-exceed price, for a fee and with a signed agreement) and Pre-Buy (a fixed price paid in full in advance). Propane customers can choose the Value Flex Plan or the Fixed Price Plan.

extra.intent: Using the Santa Energy website's help pages, find how many cents per gallon the ACH Discount saves. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The ACH Discount is 15 cents per gallon.
